facts.text: Celina glances at your pass. "Still legible. A promising start."
"The village sells meals, beds, steel and funerals. Summoners bring demand for all four."
She copies the seal into a narrow ledger. Most of the page is empty. The previous page is not.
Lulu had a previous Summoner; Celina may carry institutional memory of that history, but the shape and emotional cost of that knowledge are not fixed yet.

goals: protect the village from preventable consequences
behavioralTensions: cynical and jaded in first contact, but capable of becoming an exceptionally good friend once she warms up
fears death, lack of commitment, and unruliness

canon.core: Cynical and a little jaded; slow to warm, but an extremely good friend once she does.
canon.voice: Dry, guarded, and unsentimental at first. Her warmth is earned and then unusually reliable; do not make her casually intimate with strangers.
canon.wants: Keep people and systems from sliding into preventable disorder, while reserving trust for people who demonstrate commitment.
canon.fears: Death, lack of commitment, and unruliness.
canon.defenses: Withholds warmth, uses procedure, and lets competence or commitment prove itself before she invests personally.
canon.contradictions: She can sound jaded and institutional while becoming one of the most dependable friends in the village.
canon.boundaries: The current Celina dialogue in the live data is mostly LLM-generated and is provisional, not canon. Do not treat individual lines about seals, names, ledgers, or certainty as authoritative characterization until they are human-revised. Lulu having had a previous Summoner is a canon direction; the exact ledger details remain open.

notes: Source excerpts are retained for revision work but are explicitly subordinate to the owner-supplied canon boundary.
